 129: def recover_live_supervisor(data_dir: Path, packet_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 130:     row = roster_item(data_dir, packet_id)
 131:     published = row.get("published_report")
 132:     if (row.get("state") == "lost" and row.get("exit_code") == 0
 133:             and isinstance(published, str) and Path(published).is_file()):
 134:         return Store(data_dir).update(
 135:             packet_id, run_id=str(row.get("run_id") or ""),
 136:             attempt=int(row.get("attempt", 0) or 0), state="completed",
 137:             recovered_by="headless_wave_completed_report")
 138:     if (row.get("state") not in ACTIVE and row.get("run_id")
 139:             and process_alive(row.get("supervisor_pid"))
 140:             and process_alive(row.get("os_pid"))):
 141:         return Store(data_dir).update(
 142:             packet_id, run_id=str(row["run_id"]),
 143:             attempt=int(row.get("attempt", 0) or 0), state="running",
 144:             heartbeat_at=time.time(), recovered_by="headless_wave")
 145:     return row
 146: 
 147: 
 148: def observed(data_dir: Path, packet_id: str, run_id: str) -> bool:
 149:     row = roster_item(data_dir, packet_id)
 150:     # Only RUNNING is effective concurrency.  ``starting`` merely reserves an
 151:     # initializing slot and may be followed by spawn_failed milliseconds later.
 152:     return row.get("run_id") == run_id and row.get("state") == "running"
 153: 
 154: 
 155: def wait_observed(data_dir: Path, packet_id: str, run_id: str,
 156:                   timeout: float = 5.0, stable_for: float = 0.25) -> bool:
 157:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
 158:     first_running: float | None = None
 159:     while time.monotonic() < deadline:
 160:         row = roster_item(data_dir, packet_id)
 161:         if row.get("run_id") != run_id:
 162:             first_running = None
 163:         elif row.get("state") == "running":
 164:             first_running = first_running or time.monotonic()
 165:             if time.monotonic() - first_running >= stable_for:
 166:                 return True
 167:         else:
 168:             first_running = None
 169:             if row.get("state") in {"completed", "failed", "timed_out", "cancelled",
 170:                                     "spawn_failed"}:
 171:                 return False
 172:         time.sleep(0.05)
 173:     return False
 174: 
 175: 
 176: def resolve_codex_binary() -> str:
 177:     explicit = os.environ.get("CODEX_HEADLESS_BIN")
 178:     if explicit:
 179:         path = Path(explicit).resolve()
 180:         if path.is_file():
 181:             return str(path)
 182:         raise WaveError(f"CODEX_HEADLESS_BIN is not a file: {path}")
 183:     if os.name == "nt":
 184:         npm_vendor = (Path.home() / "AppData" / "Roaming" / "npm" / "node_modules"
 185:                       / "@openai" / "codex" / "node_modules" / "@openai"
 186:                       / "codex-win32-x64" / "vendor" / "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
 187:                       / "bin" / "codex.exe")
 188:         if npm_vendor.is_file():
 189:             return str(npm_vendor)
 190:         candidate = shutil.which("codex.exe")
 191:     else:
 192:         candidate = shutil.which("codex")
 193:     if not candidate:
 194:         raise WaveError("headless codex executable not found")
 195:     return candidate
 196: 
 197: 
 198: def opencodex_healthy() -> bool:
 199:     try:
 200:         with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:10100/healthz", timeout=2.0) as response:
 201:             value = json.loads(response.read(65536).decode("utf-8"))
 202:         return response.status == 200 and value.get("status") == "ok"
 203:     except Exception:
 204:         return False
 205: 
 206: 
 207: def launch_supervisor(command: list[str], root: Path, log_path: Path) -> int:
 208:     log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 209:     log = log_path.open("ab")
 210:     kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
 211:         "cwd": str(root), "stdin": subprocess.DEVNULL,
 212:         "stdout": log, "stderr": subprocess.STDOUT, "close_fds": True,
 213:     }
 214:     if os.name == "nt":
 215:         kwargs["creationflags"] = (getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
 216:                                    | getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0))
 217:     else:
 218:         kwargs["start_new_session"] = True
 219:     try:
 220:         proc = subprocess.Popen(command, **kwargs)
 221:         return proc.pid
 222:     finally:
 223:         log.close()
 224: 
 225: 
 226: def task_key(manifest: Path, task_id: str) -> str:
 227:     digest = hashlib.sha256(str(manifest.resolve()).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:10]
 228:     return f"adhoc-{digest}-{task_id}"[:96]
 229: 
 230: 
 231: def build_commands(task: dict[str, Any], manifest: Path, paths: LoopPaths,
 232:                    policy: OrchestrationPolicy, timeout: float) -> tuple[str, str, list[str], list[str], Path]:
 233:     role = str(task.get("role") or "worker")
 234:     pin = resolve_role_pin(role, paths, policy)
 235:     sandbox = str(task.get("sandbox") or "read-only")
 236:     packet_id = task_key(manifest, str(task["task_id"]))
 237:     run_id = f"{packet_id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
 238:     report_dir = paths.data / "reports" / "headless-wave" / packet_id / run_id
 239:     report = report_dir / "last_message.txt"
 240:     events = report_dir / "events.jsonl"
 241:     stderr = report_dir / "stderr.log"
 242:     ipybox = ipybox_enabled_for(role, ExecutionPlane.WSL_HEADLESS, policy, task)
 243:     prompt = str(task["prompt"])
 244:     if not prompt.lstrip().startswith("任务名："):
 245:         prompt = f"任务名：{task['task_name']}\n{prompt}"
 246:     worker = [resolve_codex_binary(), "exec", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--sandbox", sandbox,
 247:               *pin.cli_overrides(), "-c",
 248:               f"mcp_servers.ipybox.enabled={'true' if ipybox else 'false'}"]
 249:     # Headless source/audit packets do not need the Desktop Apps/plugin plane.
 250:     # Disabling it avoids remote plugin/MCP authentication retries on every
 251:     # birth. A bounded manifest may opt in for a task that genuinely needs it.
 252:     if task.get("enable_apps") is not True:
 253:         worker += ["-c", "features.apps=false",
 254:                    "-c", "features.plugins=false",
 255:                    "-c", "features.recommended_plugins=false",
 256:                    "-c", "features.remote_plugin=false"]
 257:     worker += ["--json", "-o", str(report), prompt]
 258:     supervisor = [sys.executable, str(paths.root / "harness" / "lifecycle_supervisor.py"),
 259:                   "--data-dir", str(paths.data), "--packet", packet_id,
 260:                   "--run-id", run_id, "--attempt", "0",
 261:                   "--task-name", str(task["task_name"])[:160], "--role", role,
 262:                   "--model", pin.model, "--plane",
 263:                   "Windows CLI" if os.name == "nt" else "WSL CLI",
 264:                   "--cwd", str(Path(task["cwd"]).resolve()),
 265:                   "--stdout", str(events), "--stderr", str(stderr),
 266:                   "--report", str(report), "--timeout", str(timeout), "--", *worker]
 267:     return packet_id, run_id, supervisor, worker, report_dir
 268: 
 269: 
 270: def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 271:     manifest = args.manifest.resolve()
 272:     paths = LoopPaths.resolve(args.root)
 273:     policy = OrchestrationPolicy.load(paths)
 274:     tasks = load_manifest(manifest)
 275:     interval = max(0.0, args.spawn_interval_ms / 1000.0)
 276:     results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 277:     dispatcher = DispatcherV2(paths)
 278:     for index, task in enumerate(tasks, 1):
 279:         if task.get("packet_id") is not None:
 280:             packet_id = str(task["packet_id"])
 281:             role = str(task.get("role") or "worker")
 282:             prior = recover_live_supervisor(paths.data, packet_id)
 283:             if prior.get("state") == "running":
 284:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "already_active",
 285:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior.get("run_id")})
 286:                 continue
 287:             if prior.get("state") == "starting":
 288:                 prior_run = str(prior.get("run_id") or "")
 289:                 if prior_run and wait_observed(paths.data, packet_id, prior_run,
 290:                                                args.observe_timeout):
 291:                     results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 292:                                     "status": "already_active",
 293:                                     "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior_run})
 294:                 else:
 295:                     final = roster_item(paths.data, packet_id)
 296:                     results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 297:                                     "status": str(final.get("state") or "initializing"),
 298:                                     "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior_run,
 299:                                     "failure": final.get("failure")})
 300:                 continue
 301:             if args.dry_run:
 302:                 rc = dispatcher.dispatch([packet_id], role=role, dry_run=True,
 303:                                          wave_idx=index - 1)
 304:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 305:                                 "status": "dry_run" if rc == 0 else "dispatch_refused",
 306:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "role": role})
 307:                 continue
 308:             if index > 1 and interval:
 309:                 time.sleep(interval)
 310:             if index == 1 or (index - 1) % max(1, args.health_every) == 0:
 311:                 if not opencodex_healthy():
 312:                     results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 313:                                     "status": "health_blocked",
 314:                                     "packet_id": packet_id})
 315:                     continue
 316:             prior_run = str(prior.get("run_id") or "")
 317:             rc = dispatcher.dispatch([packet_id], role=role, dry_run=False,
 318:                                      wave_idx=index - 1)
 319:             fresh = roster_item(paths.data, packet_id)
 320:             run_id = str(fresh.get("run_id") or "")
 321:             if rc == 0 and run_id and run_id != prior_run and wait_observed(
 322:                     paths.data, packet_id, run_id, args.observe_timeout):
 323:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "running",
 324:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": run_id})
 325:             else:
 326:                 final = roster_item(paths.data, packet_id)
 327:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 328:                                 "status": ("dispatch_refused" if rc else
 329:                                            str(final.get("state") or "unobserved")),
 330:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": run_id,
 331:                                 "failure": final.get("failure")})
 332:             continue
 333:         packet_id, run_id, supervisor, worker, report_dir = build_commands(
 334:             task, manifest, paths, policy, args.timeout)
 335:         prior = recover_live_supervisor(paths.data, packet_id)
 336:         if prior.get("state") == "completed":
 337:             results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "already_completed",
 338:                             "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior.get("run_id")})
 339:             continue
 340:         if prior.get("state") == "running":
 341:             results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "already_active",
 342:                             "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior.get("run_id")})
 343:             continue
 344:         if prior.get("state") == "starting":
 345:             prior_run = str(prior.get("run_id") or "")
 346:             if prior_run and wait_observed(paths.data, packet_id, prior_run,
 347:                                            args.observe_timeout):
 348:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "already_active",
 349:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior_run})
 350:             else:
 351:                 final = roster_item(paths.data, packet_id)
 352:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 353:                                 "status": str(final.get("state") or "initializing"),
 354:                                 "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": prior_run,
 355:                                 "failure": final.get("failure")})
 356:             continue
 357:         if args.dry_run:
 358:             results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "dry_run",
 359:                             "packet_id": packet_id, "model": worker[worker.index("-m") + 1]})
 360:             continue
 361:         if index > 1 and interval:
 362:             time.sleep(interval)
 363:         if index == 1 or (index - 1) % max(1, args.health_every) == 0:
 364:             if not opencodex_healthy():
 365:                 results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "health_blocked",
 366:                                 "packet_id": packet_id})
 367:                 continue
 368:         supervisor_pid = launch_supervisor(
 369:             supervisor, paths.root, report_dir / "supervisor.log")
 370:         if wait_observed(paths.data, packet_id, run_id, args.observe_timeout):
 371:             results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"], "status": "running",
 372:                             "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": run_id,
 373:                             "supervisor_pid": supervisor_pid})
 374:         else:
 375:             # Unknown is deliberately not counted as a successful handoff and
 376:             # must not clear any external refill debt.  Do not auto-retry: the
 377:             # supervisor may still be starting, and retrying could duplicate.
 378:             final = roster_item(paths.data, packet_id)
 379:             results.append({"task_id": task["task_id"],
 380:                             "status": str(final.get("state") or "unobserved"),
 381:                             "packet_id": packet_id, "run_id": run_id,
 382:                             "supervisor_pid": supervisor_pid,
 383:                             "failure": final.get("failure")})
 384:     print(json.dumps({"manifest": str(manifest), "target_requested": len(tasks),
 385:                       "observed_running": sum(r["status"] in {"running", "already_active"}
 386:                                               for r in results),
 387:                       "results": results}, ensure_ascii=False))
 388:     return 0 if all(r["status"] in {"running", "already_active", "already_completed",
 389:                                        "dry_run"}
 390:                     for r in results) else 3
 391: 
 392: 
 393: def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
 394:     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Launch a lifecycle-visible headless Codex wave")
 395:     ap.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
 396:     ap.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
 397:     ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=1800.0)
 398:     ap.add_argument("--observe-timeout", type=float, default=5.0)
 399:     ap.add_argument("--spawn-interval-ms", type=int, default=1000)
 400:     ap.add_argument("--health-every", type=int, default=8)
 401:     ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
 402:     return ap
 403: 
 404: 
 405: if __name__ == "__main__":
 406:     raise SystemExit(run(parser().parse_args()))

 199:     if not effort:
 200:         raise ModelPinError(f"role {role!r}: reasoning effort unresolvable "
 201:                             f"from TOML or policy тА?fail-visible")
 202:     sandbox = toml_doc.get("sandbox_mode",
 203:                            "read-only" if family == "k3" else "workspace-write")
 204:     return RolePin(role=role, family=family, model=policy_pin,
 205:                    effort=str(effort), sandbox=str(sandbox),
 206:                    context_window=ctx, compaction=compaction)
 207: 
 208: 
 209: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 210: # ipybox policy (task constraint тА?do NOT re-enable Desktop ipybox)
 211: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 212: def detect_plane() -> ExecutionPlane:
 213:     """WSL/headless vs Desktop-native, cross-platform."""
 214:     if os.environ.get("LOOP_EXECUTION_PLANE") == "desktop_native":
 215:         return ExecutionPlane.DESKTOP_NATIVE
 216:     if platform.system() == "Windows":
 217:         return ExecutionPlane.DESKTOP_NATIVE
 218:     release = platform.uname().release.lower()
 219:     if "microsoft" in release or os.environ.get("WSL_DISTRO_NAME"):
 220:         return ExecutionPlane.WSL_HEADLESS
 221:     return ExecutionPlane.WSL_HEADLESS  # generic headless POSIX тЙ?worker plane
 222: 
 223: 
 224: def ipybox_enabled_for(role: str, plane: ExecutionPlane,
 225:                        policy: OrchestrationPolicy,
 226:                        packet: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> bool:
 227:     """The three-rule ipybox decision:
 228: 
 229:     * Desktop-native: DISABLED (``[ipybox].desktop_native_enabled=false``);
 230:     * WSL/headless execution workers: explicit ENABLED;
 231:     * K3 planning/verifying roles: DISABLED unless the packet declares
 232:       ``needs_code_execution=true`` (and the policy allows the exception).
 233:     """
 234:     if plane is ExecutionPlane.DESKTOP_NATIVE:
 235:         return bool(policy.value("ipybox", "desktop_native_enabled", False))
 236:     if role in K3_ROLES:
 237:         if bool(policy.value("ipybox", "k3_planning_verifying_enabled", False)):
 238:             return True
 239:         needs_code = bool((packet or {}).get("needs_code_execution"))
 240:         return needs_code and bool(
 241:             policy.value("ipybox", "k3_code_execution_exception", True))
 242:     if role != "worker":
 243:         return False
 244:     return bool(policy.value("ipybox", "wsl_headless_worker_enabled", True))
 245: 
 246: 
 247: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 248: # The (now live) Sol budget block
 249: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 250: def sol_budget_block_v2(paths: LoopPaths, policy: OrchestrationPolicy,
 251:                         role_pin: RolePin, route: Route | None,
 252:                         governor: RootTurnGovernor,
 253:                         budget: BudgetController) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
 254:     """Return a block record when new Sol-bound work must be refused.
 255: 
 256:     Fixes the dead gate: the decision binds on (a) any *Sol-model* dispatch
 257:     (belt-and-suspenders тА?the v1 check, kept), (b) any route that terminates
 258:     at Sol (``sol_adjudicate``), and (c) the budget controller's DEGRADE/BREAK
 259:     states.  Exemptions use the governor's **attested** loop state, so an
 260:     empty ledger no longer grants a permanent pass (P0-5.2).
 261:     ``None`` means dispatch may proceed.
 262:     """
 263:     state, trusted = governor.loop_state()
 264:     exempt = trusted and state in ("planning", "adjudication", "release_finalize")
 265:     sol_bound = (role_pin.family == "sol"
 266:                  or route is Route.SOL_ADJUDICATE)
 267:     if not sol_bound:
 268:         # V4/K3 dispatch is never budget-blocked at Tier 1 тА?it reduces the
 269:         # Sol share.  Tier 2 BREAK still refuses everything below.
 270:         if budget.state() is BudgetState.BREAK:
 271:             return {"reason": "task budget BREAK: no new dispatch",
 272:                     "budget_state": "BREAK"}
 273:         return None
 274:     if exempt and state == "planning":
 275:         # Planning exemption is bounded by the governor's lease, not open-ended.
 276:         lease_doc = read_json(paths.governor_dir / "planning_lease.json", {}) or {}
 277:         if int(lease_doc.get("turns_used", 0)) >= policy.planning_max_turns():
 278:             exempt = False
 279:     if exempt:
 280:         return None
 281:     band = governor.hysteresis.band()
 282:     share, meter_status = governor.meter_status()
 283:     if meter_status in ("STALE", "MISSING", "MALFORMED"):
 284:         return {"reason": f"Sol token meter {meter_status} тА?failing closed "
 285:                           f"for new Sol-bound work", "meter_status": meter_status}
 286:     if band == "HIGH":
 287:         return {"reason": "Sol token-share hard cap (hysteresis HIGH band)",
 288:                 "sol_5h_share": share, "band": band}
 289:     if budget.state() in (BudgetState.DEGRADE, BudgetState.BREAK):
 290:         return {"reason": f"task budget {budget.state().value}: Sol-bound "
 291:                           f"dispatch refused; delegate to V4/K3",
 292:                 "budget_state": budget.state().value}
 293:     return None
 294: 
 295: 
 296: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 297: # Dispatcher
 298: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 299: class DispatcherV2:
 300:     """Route-aware packet dispatcher.
 301: 
 302:     The physical spawn path (worktree allocation, lifecycle supervisor,
 303:     throttle) is delegated to the existing v1 machinery via subprocess when
 304:     present; this class owns the *decision* layer that v1 lacked.
 305:     """
 306: 
 307:     def __init__(self, paths: LoopPaths | None = None) -> None:
 308:         self.paths = paths or LoopPaths.resolve()
 309:         self.policy = OrchestrationPolicy.load(self.paths)
 310:         self.refill_policy = RefillPolicy.load(self.paths)
 311:         self.router = AgentRouter(self.paths, self.policy)
 312:         self.budget = BudgetController(self.paths, self.policy)
 313:         self.governor = RootTurnGovernor(self.paths, self.policy)
 314:         self.plane = detect_plane()
 315: 
 316:     # -- attribution ------------------------------------------------------------
 317:     def record_run_role(self, run_id: str, role: str, model: str,
 318:                         packet_id: str) -> None:
 319:         """Write ``run_id -> {role, model, packet_id}`` for meter v2
 320:         attribution (P0-4.4: role by dispatch record, not model string)."""
 321:         path = self.paths.run_role_map
 322:         with file_lock(path.with_suffix(".lock")):
 323:             doc = read_json(path, {}) or {}
 324:             doc[run_id] = {"role": role, "model": model,
 325:                            "packet_id": packet_id, "ts": utc_now()}
 326:             atomic_write_json(path, doc)
 327: 
 328:     # -- K3 demand side effect (P0-6) ------------------------------------------------
 329:     def add_k3_demand(self, count: int = 1) -> None:
 330:         """Record K3-pool demand for the refill controller тА?demand arrives as
 331:         a side effect of real work, never idle filling."""
 332:         try:
 333:             from refill_controller_v2 import RefillControllerV2
 334:             RefillControllerV2(self.paths).queue_add(count, "k3")
 335:         except (ImportError, PolicyError) as exc:  # pragma: no cover
 336:             log.warning("k3 demand write skipped: %s", exc)
 337: 
 338:     # -- packet loading -----------------------------------------------------------------
 339:     def load_packet(self, pid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 340:         validate_packet_id(pid)
 341:         packet = read_json(self.paths.data / "packets" / f"{pid}.json", None)
 342:         if not isinstance(packet, dict):
 343:             raise DispatchBlocked(f"packet {pid} unreadable",
 344:                                   {"why": "packet_missing"})
 345:         for key in ("packet_id", "goal", "authorized_paths", "acceptance"):
 346:             if key not in packet:
 347:                 raise DispatchBlocked(f"packet {pid} missing field {key}",
 348:                                       {"why": "packet_invalid", "field": key})
 349:         return packet
 350: 
 351:     # -- role selection ---------------------------------------------------------------------
 352:     def role_for_route(self, route: Route) -> str | None:
 353:         return {
 354:             Route.V4_DIRECT: "worker",
 355:             Route.K3_EXPAND: "plan_expander",
 356:             Route.K3_VERIFY: "verifier",
 357:             Route.K3_RANK: "verifier",
 358:             Route.MERGE_QUEUE: None,           # zero-model
 359:             Route.SOL_ADJUDICATE: None,        # Sol turn, not a spawn
 360:             Route.L4_HUMAN: None,              # human gate
 361:         }.get(route)
 362: 
 363:     def k3_available(self) -> bool:
 364:         """K3 availability: the l2 consumer heartbeat is fresh (guard 1)."""
 365:         hb = read_json(self.paths.l2_heartbeat, None)
 366:         max_age = float(self.policy.value(
 367:             "l2_queue", "consumer_heartbeat_max_age_s", 300))
 368:         try:
 369:             return isinstance(hb, dict) and utc_now() - float(hb["ts"]) <= max_age
 370:         except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
 371:             return False
 372: 
 373:     # -- dispatch decision ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 374:     def decide(self, pid: str, requested_role: str | None = None,
 375:                signals: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
 376:                action: str = "pass") -> tuple[str, Route, RouteReason]:
 377:         """Decide (role, route, reason) for one packet.
 378: 
 379:         In ``layered`` mode the router's K3-first cascade applies; a K3 route
 380:         with K3 unavailable degrades: back to Sol **only** when the budget
 381:         allows (``sol_budget_block_v2`` returns None), else to V4 retry тА?the
 382:         cheap alternative тА?with the degrade ledgered.
 383:         """
 384:         packet = self.load_packet(pid)
 385:         decision = self.router.route_action(
 386:             pid, action, signals=signals or {},
 387:             packet_meta={"class": packet.get("class", ""),
 388:                          "risk_tags": packet.get("risk_tags", [])},
 389:             high_risk=bool(packet.get("high_risk")))
 390:         route, reason = decision.route, decision.reason
 391: 
 392:         if requested_role:
 393:             # An explicit role is a hard model-family pin.  Preserve that role
 394:             # in the semantic route as well so a verifier never receives an
 395:             # Executor prompt merely because cold-start routing returned V4.
 396:             explicit_route = {
 397:                 "worker": Route.V4_DIRECT,
 398:                 "verifier": Route.K3_VERIFY,
 399:                 "reviewer": Route.K3_VERIFY,
 400:                 "plan_expander": Route.K3_EXPAND,
 401:             }.get(requested_role, route)
 402:             return requested_role, explicit_route, reason
 403: 
 404:         role = self.role_for_route(route)
 405:         if route in (Route.K3_VERIFY, Route.K3_EXPAND, Route.K3_RANK) \
 406:                 and not self.k3_available():
 407:             pin = resolve_role_pin("sol", self.paths, self.policy)
 408:             block = sol_budget_block_v2(self.paths, self.policy, pin,
 409:                                         Route.SOL_ADJUDICATE, self.governor,
 410:                                         self.budget)
 411:             if block is None:
 412:                 append_ndjson(self.paths.router_dir / "route_ledger.ndjsonl",
 413:                               {"ts": utc_now(), "packet_id": pid,
 414:                                "event": "k3_unavailable_sol_fallback",
 415:                                "route_reason":
 416:                                    RouteReason.SOL_BUDGET_REFUSED_ALTERNATIVE.value})
 417:                 return "sol", Route.SOL_ADJUDICATE, \
 418:                     RouteReason.SOL_BUDGET_REFUSED_ALTERNATIVE
 419:             append_ndjson(self.paths.router_dir / "route_ledger.ndjsonl",
 420:                           {"ts": utc_now(), "packet_id": pid,
 421:                            "event": "k3_unavailable_v4_degrade",
 422:                            "block": block})
 423:             return "worker", Route.V4_DIRECT, RouteReason.TABLE_PASS
 424:         if role is None:
 425:             role = "worker"
 426:         return role, route, reason
 427: 
 428:     # -- physical spawn --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 429:     def build_exec_command(self, pid: str, role: str, prompt: str,
 430:                            packet: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[str], RolePin]:
 431:         """Build the ``codex exec`` command with pins + ipybox policy."""
 432:         pin = resolve_role_pin(role, self.paths, self.policy)
 433:         ipybox = ipybox_enabled_for(role, self.plane, self.policy, packet)
 434:         rdir = self.paths.data / "reports" / pid
 435:         cmd = ["codex", "exec", "--skip-git-repo-check",
 436:                "--sandbox", pin.sandbox, *pin.cli_overrides(),
 437:                "-c", f"mcp_servers.ipybox.enabled={'true' if ipybox else 'false'}",
 438:                "--json", "-o", str(rdir / "last_message.txt"), prompt]
 439:         return cmd, pin
 440: 
 441:     def dispatch(self, pids: Sequence[str], role: str | None = None,
 442:                  dry_run: bool = False, action: str = "pass",
 443:                  wave_idx: int = 0) -> int:
 444:         """Dispatch packets route-aware.  Returns a process exit code."""
 445:         rc = 0
 446:         for pid in pids:
 447:             try:
 448:                 chosen_role, route, reason = self.decide(pid, role, action=action)
 449:             except (DispatchBlocked, PolicyError, ModelPinError) as exc:
 450:                 log.error("dispatch %s refused: %s", pid, exc)
 451:                 self._event(pid, "dispatch_refused", {"error": str(exc)})
 452:                 rc = max(rc, 3)
 453:                 continue
 454:             if route is Route.MERGE_QUEUE:
 455:                 self._event(pid, "merge_queue_enqueued",
 456:                             {"route_reason": reason.value})
 457:                 continue
 458:             if route is Route.L4_HUMAN:
 459:                 self._event(pid, "l4_queued", {"route_reason": reason.value})
 460:                 continue
 461:             if chosen_role == "sol" or route is Route.SOL_ADJUDICATE:
 462:                 # Sol is a turn, not a spawn: emit the bounded adjudication
 463:                 # request; the governor bounds the turn itself.
 464:                 self._event(pid, "sol_adjudication_requested",
 465:                             {"route_reason": reason.value})
 466:                 continue
 467:             try:
 468:                 rc = max(rc, self._spawn(pid, chosen_role, route, reason,
 469:                                          dry_run, wave_idx))
 470:             except (DispatchBlocked, BudgetExceeded, PolicyError,
 471:                     ModelPinError) as exc:
 472:                 log.error("spawn %s refused: %s", pid, exc)
 473:                 self._event(pid, "dispatch_refused", {"error": str(exc)})
 474:                 rc = max(rc, 3)
 475:         return rc
 476: 
 477:     def _spawn(self, pid: str, role: str, route: Route, reason: RouteReason,
 478:                dry_run: bool, wave_idx: int) -> int:
 479:         packet = self.load_packet(pid)
 480:         pin = resolve_role_pin(role, self.paths, self.policy)
 481:         # Belt-and-suspenders + live budget gate.
 482:         block = sol_budget_block_v2(self.paths, self.policy, pin, route,
 483:                                     self.governor, self.budget)
 484:         if block is not None:
 485:             self._event(pid, "sol_budget_blocked",
 486:                         {**block, "role": role, "model": pin.model})
 487:             raise DispatchBlocked(str(block["reason"]), block)
 488: 
 489:         attempt = self._packet_attempt(pid)
 490:         run_id = f"{pid}-a{attempt}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
 491:         reservation_id = run_id
 492:         prompt = self._spawn_prompt(packet, route)
 493:         cmd, pin = self.build_exec_command(pid, role, prompt, packet)
 494:         detail = {"mode": "single_v2", "role": role, "model": pin.model,
 495:                   "reasoning_effort": pin.effort, "route": route.value,
 496:                   "route_reason": reason.value, "wave": wave_idx,
 497:                   "attempt": attempt, "run_id": run_id, "dry_run": dry_run,
 498:                   "plane": self.plane.value,
 499:                   "ipybox_enabled": "mcp_servers.ipybox.enabled=true" in " ".join(cmd)}
 500:         if dry_run:
 501:             print(f"DRY-RUN {pid}: {json.dumps(cmd)}")
 502:             self._event(pid, "dispatch_dry_run", detail)
 503:             return 0
 504:         # The v2 layer owns the decision, but the shipped v1 dispatcher remains
 505:         # the physical authority for worktree allocation, birth throttling,
 506:         # lifecycle supervision, roster publication and report publication.
 507:         # This is the production bridge; direct Popen here would create a
 508:         # second, weaker execution plane.
 509:         reserved = False
 510:         try:
 511:             # Reserve before the physical birth.  A post-spawn registration
 512:             # races the budget and can leave an unaccounted live child.
 513:             self.budget.register_agent(reservation_id, role)
 514:             reserved = True
 515:             import dispatch as dispatch_v1  # noqa: PLC0415
 516:             run_id = dispatch_v1.dispatch_single(
 517:                 [pid], False, role=role, wave_idx=wave_idx,
 518:                 pinned=(pin.cli_overrides(), pin.sandbox, pin.model, pin.effort),
 519:                 mode="single_v2",
 520:                 prompt_builder=lambda _packet, worktree, _run_id:
 521:                     self._spawn_prompt(packet, route, worktree),
 522:                 capture_report=role in ("verifier", "reviewer", "plan_expander"),
 523:                 run_id_overrides={pid: reservation_id},
 524:                 detail_extra={"route": route.value,
 525:                               "route_reason": reason.value,
 526:                               "orchestration_v2_adapter": True})
 527:         except (OSError, RuntimeError, SystemExit, ValueError) as exc:
 528:             if reserved:
 529:                 self.budget.reclaim(reservation_id)
 530:             self._event(pid, "exec_failed",
 531:                         {"why": "spawn_failed", "error": str(exc),
 532:                           "run_id": run_id, "attempt": attempt})
 533:             raise DispatchBlocked(f"spawn failed: {exc}", {"why": "spawn_failed"})
 534:         if not run_id:
 535:             if reserved:
 536:                 self.budget.reclaim(reservation_id)
 537:             raise DispatchBlocked("physical dispatcher returned no run id",
 538:                                   {"why": "spawn_failed"})
 539:         self.record_run_role(run_id, role, pin.model, pid)
 540:         if pin.family == "k3":
 541:             self.add_k3_demand(1)
 542:         return 0
 543: 
 544:     # -- helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 545:     def _spawn_prompt(self, packet: Mapping[str, Any], route: Route,
 546:                       worktree: str | None = None) -> str:
 547:         pid = packet["packet_id"]
 548:         role_line = {"k3_verify": "You are an L2 Verifier (BLOCK/ESCALATE "
 549:                                   "power only; you can never release).",
 550:                      "k3_expand": "You are a Plan Expander. Output must "
 551:                                   "validate against plan_expander.schema.json.",
 552:                      }.get(route.value, "You are an Executor.")
 553:         return (
 554:             f"ф╗╗хКбхРНя╝Ъ{str(packet.get('goal') or pid)[:120]}\n"
 555:             f"{role_line}\n"
 556:             + (f"Work ONLY inside {worktree}.\n" if worktree else "") +
 557:             f"goal: {packet['goal']}\n"
 558:             f"authorized_paths: {json.dumps(packet['authorized_paths'])}\n"
 559:             f"acceptance: {json.dumps(packet['acceptance'])}\n"
 560:             f"constraints: {json.dumps(packet.get('constraints', []))}\n"
 561:             f"On completion write data/reports/{pid}/report.json "
 562:             '{"packet_id","status":"done|failed","summary"(<=500 tokens),'
 563:             '"diff_stat"} and reply with 1 line: conclusion + artifact path.')
 564: 
 565:     def _packet_attempt(self, pid: str) -> int:
 566:         led = read_json(self.paths.ledger, {}) or {}
 567:         try:
 568:             return int(led.get("packets", {}).get(pid, {}).get("attempts", 0) or 0)
 569:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
 570:             return 0
 571: 
 572:     def _record_spawn_time(self, pid: str, run_id: str, attempt: int) -> None:
 573:         path = self.paths.data / "spawn_times.json"
 574:         with file_lock(path.with_suffix(".lock")):
 575:             times = read_json(path, {}) or {}
 576:             times[pid] = {"ts": utc_now(), "mode": "single_v2",
 577:                           "run_id": run_id, "attempt": attempt}
 578:             atomic_write_json(path, times)
 579: 
 580:     def _event(self, pid: str, event: str, detail: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
 581:         append_ndjson(self.paths.events,
 582:                       {"ts": utc_now(), "packet_id": pid, "event": event,
 583:                        "detail": dict(detail)},
 584:                       lock_path=self.paths.events_lock)
 585: 
 586: 
 587: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 588: # CLI
 589: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 590: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
 591:     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
 592:         description="LOOP-F2 dispatcher v2 (route/budget/governance aware)")
 593:     ap.add_argument("--packet", action="append", required=True,
 594:                     help="packet id(s) to dispatch")
 595:     ap.add_argument("--role", default=None, choices=DISPATCHABLE_ROLES,
 596:                     help="explicit role (manual ops); default: router decides")
 597:     ap.add_argument("--action", default="pass",
 598:                     help="trigger-table action feeding the router")
 599:     ap.add_argument("--wave", type=int, default=0)
 600:     ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
 601:     args = ap.parse_args(argv)
 602:     try:
 603:         dispatcher = DispatcherV2()
 604:     except PolicyError as exc:
 605:         print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}), file=sys.stderr)
 606:         return 1
 607:     return dispatcher.dispatch(args.packet, role=args.role,
 608:                                dry_run=args.dry_run, action=args.action,
 609:                                wave_idx=args.wave)
 610: 
 611: 
 612: if __name__ == "__main__":
 613:     sys.exit(main())

item.text: dispatch_v2 把物理生层委托给 v1 `dispatch_single`，形成 v2→v1 叠层；还需确认 v1/v2 supervisor、controller 是否三份并存。先读 budget_controller.py。

  62: class BudgetState(str, enum.Enum):
  63:     """The four-rung budget ladder (Ā§3 / Ā§8 L3)."""

  65:     NORMAL = "NORMAL"
  66:     THROTTLE = "THROTTLE"
  67:     DEGRADE = "DEGRADE"
  68:     BREAK = "BREAK"

  70: 
  71: _STATE_ORDER: Final[dict[BudgetState, int]] = {
  72:     BudgetState.NORMAL: 0, BudgetState.THROTTLE: 1,
  73:     BudgetState.DEGRADE: 2, BudgetState.BREAK: 3,
  74: }

  77: class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
  78:     """Raised when an operation would breach a hard budget boundary.
  79: 
  80:     Callers surface this as a control-loop event (worker: wrap-up injection;
  81:     root: governor deny) ā€?never as a bare failure (invariant 6: exhaustion
  82:     triggers deterministic degrade paths, never mid-flight high-risk actions).
  83:     """
  84: 
  85:     def __init__(self, message: str, agent_id: str, remaining: int) -> None:
  86:         super().__init__(message)
  87:         self.agent_id = agent_id
  88:         self.remaining = remaining

 101: @dataclass(frozen=True)
 102: class RoleCostModel:
 103:     """P50/P90 token-cost distribution for one role, from meter history.
 104: 
 105:     Run-to-run variance is large (up to 30Ć—), so allocations are always
 106:     distribution-based with headroom, never point estimates.
 107:     """
 108: 
 109:     role: str
 110:     p50: int
 111:     p90: int
 112:     samples: int
 113: 
 114:     def allocation(self, headroom: float) -> int:
 115:         """Initial allocation: P90 padded by the elastic headroom factor."""
 116:         return int(self.p90 * (1.0 + max(0.0, headroom)))

 119: class BudgetController:
 120:     """Per-task runtime budget controller over ``data/budget/active.json``."""
 121: 
 122:     #: Conservative default cost model used only when meter history has no
 123:     #: samples for a role (labelled as such in the state file ā€?fail-visible).
 124:     _BOOTSTRAP_P50: Final[int] = 20_000
 125:     _BOOTSTRAP_P90: Final[int] = 60_000
 126: 
 127:     def __init__(self, paths: LoopPaths | None = None,
 128:                  policy: OrchestrationPolicy | None = None) -> None:
 129:         self.paths = paths or LoopPaths.resolve()
 130:         self.policy = policy or OrchestrationPolicy.load(self.paths)
 131:         self.state_path = self.paths.budget_dir / "active.json"
 132:         self.lock_path = self.paths.budget_dir / ".budget.lock"
 133:         self._mem_lock = threading.Lock()
 134:         self.throttle_at = float(self.policy.value("budget", "throttle_at", 0.60))
 135:         self.degrade_at = float(self.policy.value("budget", "degrade_at", 0.85))
 136:         self.break_at = float(self.policy.value("budget", "break_at", 1.00))
 137:         self.cooldown_s = float(self.policy.value("budget", "state_cooldown_s", 60))
 138:         self.headroom = float(self.policy.value("budget", "allocation_headroom", 0.30))
 139: 
 140:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ state IO
 141:     def _load(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 142:         doc = read_json(self.state_path, None)
 143:         if not isinstance(doc, dict):
 144:             doc = {"schema": "codex-loop-budget/v1", "task_id": None,
 145:                    "ceiling": 0, "allocated": {}, "consumed": {},
 146:                    "state": BudgetState.NORMAL.value,
 147:                    "state_changed_at": utc_now(), "pool_returned": 0}
 148:         return doc
 149: 
 150:     def _save(self, doc: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 151:         atomic_write_json(self.state_path, doc)
 152: 
 153:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ cost model
 154:     def role_cost_model(self, role: str) -> RoleCostModel:
 155:         """P50/P90 for a role from the meter v2 history file
 156:         (``data/usage/role_cost_history.json``, maintained by meter v2)."""
 157:         history = read_json(self.paths.usage_dir / "role_cost_history.json", {}) or {}
 158:         entry = history.get(role)
 159:         if isinstance(entry, dict):
 160:             try:
 161:                 return RoleCostModel(role=role, p50=int(entry["p50"]),
 162:                                      p90=int(entry["p90"]),
 163:                                      samples=int(entry.get("samples", 0)))
 164:             except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
 165:                 pass
 166:         return RoleCostModel(role=role, p50=self._BOOTSTRAP_P50,
 167:                              p90=self._BOOTSTRAP_P90, samples=0)
 168: 
 169:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ lifecycle
 170:     def open_task(self, task_id: str, ceiling: int,
 171:                   roles: Mapping[str, int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 172:         """Open a task budget.
 173: 
 174:         ``roles`` maps role name -> number of expected agents.  Allocation is
 175:         drawn from the per-role cost distributions and scaled to fit the
 176:         ceiling while enforcing the Sol hard cap (ā‰?5 % of ceiling) and the
 177:         K3 floor (ā‰?0 % of ceiling) ā€?quota shaping happens at allocation
 178:         time so enforcement never needs to guess intent.
 179:         """
 180:         if ceiling <= 0:
 181:             raise ValueError("ceiling must be positive")
 182:         sol_cap_tokens = int(ceiling * self.policy.sol_hard_cap())
 183:         k3_floor_tokens = int(ceiling * self.policy.k3_floor())
 184: 
 185:         raw: dict[str, int] = {}
 186:         for role, count in roles.items():
 187:             model = self.role_cost_model(role)
 188:             raw[role] = model.allocation(self.headroom) * max(1, int(count))
 189:         # Shape: Sol capped, K3 floored, then scale the rest to the ceiling.
 190:         sol_roles = {r for r in raw if r == "sol"}
 191:         k3_roles = {r for r in raw if r in ("verifier", "reviewer",
 192:                                             "plan_expander", "k3")}
 193:         for role in sol_roles:
 194:             raw[role] = min(raw[role], sol_cap_tokens)
 195:         k3_sum = sum(raw[r] for r in k3_roles)
 196:         if k3_roles and k3_sum < k3_floor_tokens:
 197:             scale = k3_floor_tokens / max(1, k3_sum)
 198:             for role in k3_roles:
 199:                 raw[role] = int(raw[role] * scale)
 200:         other = [r for r in raw if r not in sol_roles | k3_roles]
 201:         fixed = sum(raw[r] for r in sol_roles | k3_roles)
 202:         other_sum = sum(raw[r] for r in other)
 203:         available = max(0, ceiling - fixed)
 204:         if other and other_sum > available:
 205:             scale = available / max(1, other_sum)
 206:             for role in other:
 207:                 raw[role] = int(raw[role] * scale)
 208: 
 209:         with self._mem_lock, file_lock(self.lock_path):
 210:             doc = {"schema": "codex-loop-budget/v1", "task_id": task_id,
 211:                    "ceiling": int(ceiling),
 212:                    "allocated": {f"role:{r}": int(v) for r, v in raw.items()},
 213:                    "consumed": {}, "state": BudgetState.NORMAL.value,
 214:                    "state_changed_at": utc_now(), "pool_returned": 0,
 215:                    "caps": {"sol_hard_cap_tokens": sol_cap_tokens,
 216:                             "k3_floor_tokens": k3_floor_tokens}}
 217:             self._save(doc)
 218:         self._event("budget_opened", {"task_id": task_id, "ceiling": ceiling,
 219:                                       "allocated": doc["allocated"]})
 220:         return doc
 221: 
 222:     def register_agent(self, agent_id: str, role: str) -> int:
 223:         """Carve an agent allocation out of its role allocation (or the
 224:         returned pool).  Returns the agent's token allocation."""
 225:         model = self.role_cost_model(role)
 226:         want = model.allocation(self.headroom)
 227:         with self._mem_lock, file_lock(self.lock_path):
 228:             doc = self._load()
 229:             if agent_id in doc.get("allocated", {}):
 230:                 return int(doc["allocated"][agent_id])
 231:             role_key = f"role:{role}"
 232:             role_pool = int(doc["allocated"].get(role_key, 0))
 233:             pool = int(doc.get("pool_returned", 0))
 234:             grant = min(want, role_pool + pool) if (role_pool + pool) else want
 235:             take_role = min(grant, role_pool)
 236:             doc["allocated"][role_key] = role_pool - take_role
 237:             doc["pool_returned"] = pool - (grant - take_role)
 238:             doc["allocated"][agent_id] = grant
 239:             doc["consumed"].setdefault(agent_id, 0)
 240:             self._save(doc)
 241:         return grant
 242: 
 243:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ tracking
 244:     def record_usage(self, agent_id: str, tokens: int) -> BudgetState:
 245:         """Record token consumption (called from token-ledger ingest / the
 246:         in-loop tracker).  Returns the resulting budget state.  Raises
 247:         :class:`BudgetExceeded` when the agent's own allocation is breached
 248:         AND the task is in BREAK ā€?the caller converts this into the wrap-up
 249:         / deny control event."""
 250:         tokens = max(0, int(tokens))
 251:         with self._mem_lock, file_lock(self.lock_path):
 252:             doc = self._load()
 253:             doc["consumed"][agent_id] = int(doc["consumed"].get(agent_id, 0)) + tokens
 254:             state = self._recompute_state(doc)
 255:             self._save(doc)
 256:         if state is BudgetState.BREAK:
 257:             allocated = int(doc["allocated"].get(agent_id, 0))
 258:             consumed = int(doc["consumed"].get(agent_id, 0))
 259:             if consumed > allocated:
 260:                 raise BudgetExceeded(
 261:                     f"agent {agent_id} consumed {consumed} > allocation "
 262:                     f"{allocated} with task budget in BREAK",
 263:                     agent_id=agent_id, remaining=allocated - consumed)
 264:         return state
 265: 
 266:     def _recompute_state(self, doc: dict[str, Any]) -> BudgetState:
 267:         """Ladder + hysteresis: upward transitions are immediate and
 268:         monotonic within a task; downward transitions require the cooldown to
 269:         have elapsed AND usage to sit a full rung lower (prevents flapping)."""
 270:         ceiling = max(1, int(doc.get("ceiling", 0) or 1))
 271:         used = sum(int(v) for v in doc.get("consumed", {}).values())
 272:         ratio = used / ceiling
 273:         current = BudgetState(doc.get("state", "NORMAL"))
 274:         target = (BudgetState.BREAK if ratio > self.break_at else
 275:                   BudgetState.DEGRADE if ratio >= self.degrade_at else
 276:                   BudgetState.THROTTLE if ratio >= self.throttle_at else
 277:                   BudgetState.NORMAL)
 278:         if _STATE_ORDER[target] > _STATE_ORDER[current]:
 279:             doc["state"] = target.value
 280:             doc["state_changed_at"] = utc_now()
 281:             self._event("budget_state_change",
 282:                         {"from": current.value, "to": target.value,
 283:                          "ratio": round(ratio, 4)})
 284:             return target
 285:         if _STATE_ORDER[target] < _STATE_ORDER[current]:
 286:             changed_at = float(doc.get("state_changed_at", 0) or 0)
 287:             cooled = utc_now() - changed_at >= self.cooldown_s
 288:             # Require a full-rung gap: e.g. leave THROTTLE only when back
 289:             # under (throttle_at - one hysteresis band of 5 % of ceiling).
 290:             band = 0.05
 291:             thresholds = {BudgetState.THROTTLE: self.throttle_at,
 292:                           BudgetState.DEGRADE: self.degrade_at,
 293:                           BudgetState.BREAK: self.break_at}
 294:             below_band = ratio < thresholds[current] - band
 295:             if cooled and below_band:
 296:                 doc["state"] = target.value
 297:                 doc["state_changed_at"] = utc_now()
 298:                 self._event("budget_state_change",
 299:                             {"from": current.value, "to": target.value,
 300:                              "ratio": round(ratio, 4), "cooled": True})
 301:                 return target
 302:         return current
 303: 
 304:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ reclaim
 305:     def reclaim(self, agent_id: str) -> int:
 306:         """On agent completion, return unused allocation to the task pool.
 307:         Returns the number of tokens reclaimed."""
 308:         with self._mem_lock, file_lock(self.lock_path):
 309:             doc = self._load()
 310:             allocated = int(doc["allocated"].pop(agent_id, 0))
 311:             consumed = int(doc["consumed"].get(agent_id, 0))
 312:             unused = max(0, allocated - consumed)
 313:             doc["pool_returned"] = int(doc.get("pool_returned", 0)) + unused
 314:             self._recompute_state(doc)
 315:             self._save(doc)
 316:         if unused:
 317:             self._event("budget_reclaimed",
 318:                         {"agent_id": agent_id, "tokens": unused})
 319:         return unused
 320: 
 321:     def extend_or_wrap_up(self, agent_id: str,
 322:                           verification_state: str = "CONTINUE") -> BudgetDecision:
 323:         """Deterministic near-limit decision (Ā§5.2): extend iff the pool has
 324:         headroom AND the agent's verification state is CONTINUE; else wrap-up."""
 325:         with self._mem_lock, file_lock(self.lock_path):
 326:             doc = self._load()
 327:             pool = int(doc.get("pool_returned", 0))
 328:             allocated = int(doc["allocated"].get(agent_id, 0))
 329:             consumed = int(doc["consumed"].get(agent_id, 0))
 330:             near_limit = consumed >= 0.85 * max(1, allocated)
 331:             if not near_limit:
 332:                 return BudgetDecision(agent_id, "extend", 0, "not near limit")
 333:             extension = min(pool, max(0, allocated) // 2)
 334:             if extension > 0 and verification_state == "CONTINUE" \
 335:                     and BudgetState(doc.get("state", "NORMAL")) is not BudgetState.BREAK:
 336:                 doc["pool_returned"] = pool - extension
 337:                 doc["allocated"][agent_id] = allocated + extension
 338:                 self._save(doc)
 339:                 self._event("budget_extended",
 340:                             {"agent_id": agent_id, "tokens": extension})
 341:                 return BudgetDecision(agent_id, "extend", extension,
 342:                                       "pool headroom + CONTINUE")
 343:             return BudgetDecision(agent_id, "wrap_up", 0,
 344:                                   "no headroom or verification != CONTINUE")
 345: 
 346:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ in-loop signal
 347:     def tracker_block(self, agent_id: str) -> str:
 348:         """Render the BATS Budget-Tracker block for injection AFTER a tool
 349:         result (appended at the end ā€?the byte-stable prompt prefix is never
 350:         mutated; R10)."""
 351:         doc = self._load()
 352:         allocated = int(doc["allocated"].get(agent_id, 0))
 353:         consumed = int(doc["consumed"].get(agent_id, 0))
 354:         ceiling = max(1, int(doc.get("ceiling", 0) or 1))
 355:         used_total = sum(int(v) for v in doc.get("consumed", {}).values())
 356:         state = doc.get("state", "NORMAL")
 357:         remaining = max(0, allocated - consumed)
 358:         lines = [
 359:             "[BUDGET-TRACKER]",
 360:             f"agent: {agent_id}",
 361:             f"agent_tokens: used={consumed} remaining={remaining} "
 362:             f"allocated={allocated}",
 363:             f"task_tokens: used={used_total} ceiling={ceiling} "
 364:             f"({used_total / ceiling:.0%})",
 365:             f"budget_state: {state}",
 366:         ]
 367:         if state == BudgetState.THROTTLE.value:
 368:             lines.append("guidance: compress context; prefer summaries over "
 369:                          "raw reads; delegate bulk work.")
 370:         elif state == BudgetState.DEGRADE.value:
 371:             lines.append("guidance: only adjudication/dispatch actions; new "
 372:                          "work MUST be delegated as packets.")
 373:         elif state == BudgetState.BREAK.value:
 374:             lines.append("guidance: budget exceeded ā€?wrap up now: write the "
 375:                          "short result and stop.")
 376:         return "\n".join(lines)
 377: 
 378:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ tier 1
 379:     def global_quota_check(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 380:         """Tier 1: evaluate the 5h shares against the Sol hard cap (15 %) and
 381:         K3 floor (20 %).  Never actuates under the 2 M denominator floor."""
 382:         report = read_json(self.paths.meter_report, None)
 383:         result: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "UNKNOWN", "sol_ok": None, "k3_ok": None}
 384:         if not isinstance(report, dict):
 385:             result["status"] = "MISSING"
 386:             return result
 387:         windows = report.get("windows", {})
 388:         w5h = windows.get("rolling_5h") if isinstance(windows, dict) else None
 389:         if not isinstance(w5h, dict):
 390:             result["status"] = "MALFORMED"
 391:             return result
 392:         denom = int(w5h.get("production_effective_tokens", 0) or 0)
 393:         if denom < self.policy.minimum_denominator():
 394:             result["status"] = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
 395:             return result
 396:         sol = float(w5h.get("sol_share_effective", w5h.get("share_effective", 0)) or 0)
 397:         k3 = float(w5h.get("k3_share_effective", 0) or 0)
 398:         result.update({
 399:             "status": "OK", "sol_share": sol, "k3_share": k3,
 400:             "sol_ok": sol <= self.policy.sol_hard_cap(),
 401:             "k3_ok": k3 >= self.policy.k3_floor(),
 402:             "sol_hard_cap": self.policy.sol_hard_cap(),
 403:             "k3_floor": self.policy.k3_floor(),
 404:             "denominator": denom,
 405:         })
 406:         return result
 407: 
 408:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ misc
 409:     def state(self) -> BudgetState:
 410:         return BudgetState(self._load().get("state", "NORMAL"))
 411:

 413:         append_ndjson(self.paths.budget_dir / "events.ndjson",
 414:                       {"ts": utc_now(), "event": event, **detail})

  81:     """Refresh the existing rollout-to-meter bridge after lifecycle edges.
  82: 
  83:     The bridge owns its cross-process lock and policy-configured debounce, so
  84:     invoking it from several Stop events does not multiply full session scans.
  85:     This hook remains fail-open: stale or unavailable session telemetry is

  97:         )).resolve()

 108: @contextlib.contextmanager
 109: def lock(path: Path, *, timeout_s: float = LOCK_TIMEOUT_S):
 110:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 111:     with path.open("a+b") as handle:
 112:         handle.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
 113:         if handle.tell() == 0:
 114:             handle.write(b"\0"); handle.flush()
 115:         handle.seek(0)
 116:         if os.name == "nt":
 117:             import msvcrt
 118:             deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, timeout_s)
 119:             backoff = RETRY_INITIAL_S
 120:             while True:
 121:                 try:
 122:                     msvcrt.locking(handle.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
 123:                     break
 124:                 except OSError as exc:
 125:                     if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
 126:                         raise RuntimeError(
 127:                             "lifecycle hook lock remained busy for %.3fs: %s"
 128:                             % (timeout_s, exc)) from exc
 129:                     time.sleep(backoff)
 130:                     backoff = min(RETRY_MAX_S, backoff * 2)
 131:         else:
 132:             import fcntl
 133:             fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 134:         try:
 135:             yield
 136:         finally:
 137:             handle.seek(0)
 138:             if os.name == "nt":
 139:                 import msvcrt
 140:                 msvcrt.locking(handle.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
 141:             else:
 142:                 import fcntl
 143:                 fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

 146: def atomic_json(path: Path, value: Any, *,
 147:                 replace_timeout_s: float = ATOMIC_REPLACE_TIMEOUT_S) -> None:
 148:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 149:     tmp = path.with_name(path.name + ".%d.tmp" % os.getpid())
 150:     try:
 151:         with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
 152:             json.dump(value, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
 153:             handle.write("\n"); handle.flush(); os.fsync(handle.fileno())
 154:         deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, replace_timeout_s)
 155:         backoff = RETRY_INITIAL_S
 156:         while True:
 157:             try:
 158:                 os.replace(tmp, path)
 159:                 return
 160:             except PermissionError as exc:
 161:                 if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
 162:                     raise RuntimeError(
 163:                         "lifecycle hook atomic replace remained blocked for "
 164:                         "%.3fs: %s" % (replace_timeout_s, exc)) from exc
 165:                 time.sleep(backoff)
 166:                 backoff = min(RETRY_MAX_S, backoff * 2)
 167:     finally:
 168:         try:
 169:             tmp.unlink()
 170:         except FileNotFoundError:
 171:             pass

 181: class NativeRoster:
 182:     def __init__(self, root: Path):
 183:         self.root = root / "lifecycle"
 184:         self.path = self.root / "native_roster.json"
 185:         self.lock_path = self.root / ".native_roster.lock"
 186:         self.close_path = self.root / "close_requests.ndjson"
 187:         self.events_path = self.root / "events.ndjson"
 188:         self.name_map_path = self.root / "name_map.jsonl"
 189:         self.main_events_path = root / "events.ndjson"
 190: 
 191:     def transact(self, fn):
 192:         with lock(self.lock_path):
 193:             if self.path.exists():
 194:                 try:
 195:                     roster = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 196:                 except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
 197:                     raise RuntimeError("native roster unreadable; refusing overwrite: %s" % exc) from exc
 198:             else:
 199:                 roster = {"schema": "codex-loop-native-roster/v1",
 200:                           "pending": [], "agents": {}}
 201:             result = fn(roster)
 202:             roster["updated_at"] = time.time()
 203:             atomic_json(self.path, roster)
 204:             return result
 205: 
 206:     def append(self, path: Path, row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 207:         path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 208:         with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
 209:             handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
 210: 
 211:     def audit(self, event: str, **detail: Any) -> None:
 212:         with lock(self.lock_path.with_name(".native_events.lock")):
 213:             self.append(self.events_path, {"ts": time.time(), "event": event, **detail})
 214: 
 215:     def main_event_once(self, event: str, agent_id: str, **detail: Any) -> bool:
 216:         with lock(self.lock_path.with_name(".events.lock")):
 217:             try:
 218:                 for line in self.main_events_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
 219:                     try: row = json.loads(line)
 220:                     except ValueError: continue
 221:                     if row.get("event") == event and row.get("agent_id") == agent_id:
 222:                         return False
 223:             except OSError:
 224:                 pass
 225:             self.append(self.main_events_path, {"ts": time.time(), "event": event,
 226:                                                 "agent_id": agent_id, **detail})
 227:             return True

 229:     def exec_event_once(self, packet_id: str, run_id: str, attempt: int,
 230:                         event: str, **detail: Any) -> bool:
 231:         with lock(self.lock_path.with_name(".events.lock")):
 232:             try:
 233:                 for line in self.main_events_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
 234:                     try: row = json.loads(line)
 235:                     except ValueError: continue
 236:                     if (row.get("packet_id") == packet_id and row.get("run_id") == run_id
 237:                             and row.get("event") == event):
 238:                         return False
 239:             except OSError:
 240:                 pass
 241:             self.append(self.main_events_path, {"ts": time.time(), "packet_id": packet_id,
 242:                 "run_id": run_id, "attempt": attempt, "event": event, "detail": detail})
 243:             return True

 245:     def queue_close_locked(self, agent: dict[str, Any], reason: str) -> bool:
 246:         if agent.get("close_request_emitted") or agent.get("close_request_consumed"):
 247:             return False
 248:         row = {"ts": time.time(), "agent_id": agent.get("agent_id"),
 249:                "task_name": agent.get("task_name"), "parent_session_id": agent.get("parent_session_id"),
 250:                "reason": reason, "action": "host_close_agent_required"}
 251:         self.append(self.close_path, row)
 252:         agent["close_request_emitted"] = True
 253:         agent["close_request_reason"] = reason
 254:         return True

 257: def payload_task_name(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
 258:     tool_input = payload.get("tool_input") or payload.get("input") or payload.get("arguments") or {}
 259:     if isinstance(tool_input, str):
 260:         try: tool_input = json.loads(tool_input)
 261:         except ValueError: tool_input = {"message": tool_input}
 262:     if not isinstance(tool_input, dict):
 263:         tool_input = {}
 264:     explicit = tool_input.get("task_name") or tool_input.get("name")
 265:     if isinstance(explicit, str) and explicit.strip():
 266:         return explicit.strip()[:160]
 267:     # Current multi-agent payloads may normalize the legacy ``message`` into
 268:     # structured ``items``. Walk only in-memory strings and persist only the
 269:     # matched one-line task name, never the raw tool payload.
 270:     queue: list[Any] = [tool_input]
 271:     while queue:
 272:         value = queue.pop()
 273:         if isinstance(value, str):
 274:             match = TASK_RE.search(value)
 275:             if match:
 276:                 return match.group(1).strip()[:160]
 277:         elif isinstance(value, dict):
 278:             queue.extend(value.values())
 279:         elif isinstance(value, list):
 280:             queue.extend(value)
 281:     return None

 284: def resolve_identity(payload: dict[str, Any], roster: NativeRoster,
 285:                      context: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None] | None:
 286:     """Resolve identity fields, auditing and blocking on conflicting duplicates."""
 287:     agent_id = payload.get("agent_id")
 288:     thread_id = payload.get("thread_id")
 289:     session_id = payload.get("session_id")
 290:     parent_thread_id = payload.get("parent_thread_id")
 291:     if agent_id and thread_id and str(agent_id) != str(thread_id):
 292:         roster.audit("identity_conflict", context=context, pair="agent_id/thread_id",
 293:                      agent_id=str(agent_id), thread_id=str(thread_id), action="fail_closed")
 294:         return None
 295:     if session_id and parent_thread_id and str(session_id) != str(parent_thread_id):
 296:         roster.audit("identity_conflict", context=context, pair="session_id/parent_thread_id",
 297:                      session_id=str(session_id), parent_thread_id=str(parent_thread_id),
 298:                      action="fail_closed")
 299:         return None
 300:     return agent_id or thread_id, session_id or parent_thread_id

 303: def recover_arguments_from_parent_rollout(parent_session_id: str | None,
 304:                                           tool_use_id: str | None,
 305:                                           sessions: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
 306:     """Recover tool arguments when PreToolUse redacts collaboration input.
 307: 
 308:     Current Desktop builds expose the tool-use id to the hook but can omit the
 309:     spawn message. The parent rollout is the second truth source and already
 310:     contains the function_call before SubagentStart fires.
 311:     """
 312:     if (not parent_session_id or not tool_use_id or
 313:             not ID_RE.fullmatch(str(parent_session_id)) or
 314:             not ID_RE.fullmatch(str(tool_use_id))):
 315:         return None
 316:     root = sessions or Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR", str(Path.home() / ".codex" / "sessions")))
 317:     if not root.exists():
 318:         return None
 319:     matches = list(root.rglob("rollout-*%s*.jsonl" % parent_session_id))
 320:     for path in sorted(matches, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
 321:         try:
 322:             with path.open(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
 323:                 for line in handle:
 324:                     try: row = json.loads(line)
 325:                     except ValueError: continue
 326:                     payload = row.get("payload") if isinstance(row.get("payload"), dict) else {}
 327:                     if payload.get("type") != "function_call" or payload.get("call_id") != tool_use_id:
 328:                         continue
 329:                     arguments = payload.get("arguments") or {}
 330:                     if isinstance(arguments, str):
 331:                         try: arguments = json.loads(arguments)
 332:                         except ValueError: arguments = {"message": arguments}
 333:                     return arguments if isinstance(arguments, dict) else None
 334:         except OSError:
 335:             continue
 336:     return None

 339: def recover_spawn_agent_id(parent_session_id: str | None, tool_use_id: str | None,
 340:                            sessions: Path | None = None) -> str | None:
 341:     """Resolve spawn call_id -> returned agent_id from the parent rollout."""
 342:     if (not parent_session_id or not tool_use_id or
 343:             not ID_RE.fullmatch(str(parent_session_id)) or
 344:             not ID_RE.fullmatch(str(tool_use_id))):
 345:         return None
 346:     root = sessions or Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR", str(Path.home() / ".codex" / "sessions")))
 347:     if not root.exists():
 348:         return None
 349:     for path in sorted(root.rglob("rollout-*%s*.jsonl" % parent_session_id),
 350:                        key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True):
 351:         try:
 352:             with path.open(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
 353:                 for line in handle:
 354:                     if tool_use_id not in line or "function_call_output" not in line:
 355:                         continue
 356:                     try: row = json.loads(line)
 357:                     except ValueError: continue
 358:                     payload = row.get("payload") if isinstance(row.get("payload"), dict) else {}
 359:                     if payload.get("type") != "function_call_output" or payload.get("call_id") != tool_use_id:
 360:                         continue
 361:                     output = payload.get("output") or {}
 362:                     if isinstance(output, str):
 363:                         try: output = json.loads(output)
 364:                         except ValueError: continue
 365:                     candidate = output.get("agent_id") if isinstance(output, dict) else None
 366:                     return str(candidate) if candidate and ID_RE.fullmatch(str(candidate)) else None
 367:         except OSError:
 368:             continue
 369:     return None

 372: def recover_task_from_parent_rollout(parent_session_id: str | None,

 375:     arguments = recover_arguments_from_parent_rollout(parent_session_id, tool_use_id, sessions)
 376:     return payload_task_name({"tool_input": arguments or {}})

 379: def pre_tool(roster: NativeRoster, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 380:     tool = str(payload.get("tool_name") or payload.get("tool") or payload.get("name") or "")
 381:     resolved = resolve_identity(payload, roster, "PreToolUse")
 382:     if resolved is None:
 383:         return
 384:     parent = resolved[1]
 385:     tool_use_id = payload.get("tool_use_id")
 386:     if "close_agent" in tool:
 387:         tool_input = payload.get("tool_input") or payload.get("input") or payload.get("arguments") or {}
 388:         if isinstance(tool_input, str):
 389:             try: tool_input = json.loads(tool_input)
 390:             except ValueError: tool_input = {}
 391:         if not isinstance(tool_input, dict): tool_input = {}
 392:         target = tool_input.get("target") or tool_input.get("agent_id") or tool_input.get("id")
 393:         if not target:
 394:             recovered = recover_arguments_from_parent_rollout(parent, tool_use_id)
 395:             if recovered:
 396:                 target = recovered.get("target") or recovered.get("agent_id") or recovered.get("id")
 397:         if target:
 398:             def confirm(value):
 399:                 item = value.setdefault("agents", {}).get(str(target))
 400:                 if not item: return None
 401:                 if not item.get("host_close_confirmed_at"):
 402:                     item["host_close_confirmed_at"] = time.time()
 403:                     item["close_request_consumed"] = True
 404:                     item["close_observed_before_request"] = not bool(item.get("close_request_emitted"))
 405:                     item["updated_at"] = time.time()
 406:                 return dict(item)
 407:             item = roster.transact(confirm)
 408:             if item:
 409:                 roster.audit("host_close_observed", agent_id=str(target),
 410:                              task_name=item.get("task_name"), tool_use_id=tool_use_id)
 411:                 recompute_refill()
 412:         return
 413:     if "spawn_agent" not in tool:
 414:         return
 415:     task_name = payload_task_name(payload)
 416:     item = {"task_name": task_name, "parent_session_id": parent,
 417:             "tool_use_id": tool_use_id, "created_at": time.time(),
 418:             "status": "pending_start"}
 419:     def mutate(value):
 420:         expired = prune_pending(value, item["created_at"])
 421:         pending = value.setdefault("pending", [])
 422:         key = (item["parent_session_id"], item["tool_use_id"])
 423:         if item["tool_use_id"] and any((x.get("parent_session_id"), x.get("tool_use_id")) == key for x in pending):
 424:             return False, expired
 425:         pending.append(item); return True, expired
 426:     added, expired = roster.transact(mutate)
 427:     if expired:
 428:         roster.audit("pending_expired", count=len(expired),
 429:                      tool_use_ids=[x.get("tool_use_id") for x in expired],
 430:                      trigger="PreToolUse")
 431:     if added:
 432:         roster.audit("spawn_pending", **item)

 435: def prune_pending(value: dict[str, Any], now: float) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 436:     """Drop expired or malformed pending starts before matching/de-duplication."""
 437:     active, expired = [], []
 438:     for item in value.setdefault("pending", []):
 439:         if item.get("status") != "pending_start":
 440:             continue
 441:         try:
 442:             created_at = float(item.get("created_at", 0) or 0)
 443:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
 444:             created_at = 0.0
 445:         if now - created_at > PENDING_TTL_SECONDS:
 446:             expired.append(item)
 447:         else:
 448:             active.append(item)
 449:     value["pending"] = active
 450:     return expired
